instrument_name: Missouri Employer's Tax Guide Form 4282 (Revised 03-2026, published Dec 2025) - 2026 withholding formula, filing frequencies, due dates, W-2/MO W-3
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026 formula: annualise wages (260/52/26/24/12); subtract standard deduction Single 16,100 / Married spouse works 16,100 / MFS 16,100 / Married spouse does not work 32,200 / HoH 24,150; annual brackets in steps of 1,348: 0% to 1,348; 2% to 2,696; 2.5% to 4,044; 3% to 5,392; 3.5% to 6,740; 4% to 8,088; 4.5% to 9,436; 4.7% over 9,436 (DOR example rounds each full lower bracket to whole dollars 27/34/40/47/54/61 = 263); divide by periods; round withholding to nearest whole dollar. Guide example (married spouse works, 35,000) = 707.81/yr, 59/month - re-derived. MO W-4 (filing status, Line 2 additional, Line 3 fixed amount); no MO W-4 = single. Supplemental paid separately: flat 4.7% or aggregate; with regular pay: aggregate. Wages = federal definition. Household employers not required to withhold (voluntary by agreement). Filing: monthly if 500+/month in 2 of prior 12 months; quarterly if 100+ in a quarter; annual if <100 each quarter; quarter-monthly payment if 9,000+ in each of 2 months of prior 12 (periods 1-7, 8-15, 16-22, 23-end; pay within 3 banking days; 90% safe harbour). MO-941 monthly due 15th of following month except quarter-end month = last day of following month. Annual: W-2 + MO W-3 by last day of January (electronic) / end of February (paper); 250+ W-2s must file electronically in EFW2 incl. RV record. Timely compensation deduction 2%/1%/0.5% (YTD 0-5,000 / 5,001-10,000 / >10,000). Interest 7% for 2026. No reciprocity with any state; MO W-4A nonresident percentage; MO W-4C difference withholding

instrument_name: RSMo 290.502 Minimum wage rate (as amended by L. 2025 H.B. 567)
figure_or_rule_carried: Minimum wage 13.75/h from 2025-01-01; 15.00/h from 2026-01-01; or the federal rate if higher. CPI-W indexation (subs. 2) ran only through Dec 31 2024; the version in force since 2025-08-28 (H.B. 567) carries no indexation after 2026 (the Prop A 2024 version, in force 2024-11-05 to 2025-08-28 per the version list, is superseded). Public employers (state and political subdivisions) covered from 2025-08-28. No 2027 increase in the text.

instrument_name: RSMo 290.600 (paid sick leave) - repealed by L. 2025 H.B. 567
figure_or_rule_carried: Section 290.600 shows '(Repealed L. 2025 H.B. 567, et al.)' effective 28 Aug 2025; version list: in force 11/5/2024 to 8/28/2025. Proposition A (2024) earned paid sick time no longer in force from 2025-08-28: no state paid-sick-leave accrual in 2026.

instrument_name: RSMo 290.110 Payment due discharged employee - penalty for delay
figure_or_rule_carried: On discharge or refusal to further employ: unpaid wages due on the day of discharge; employee may request in writing that pay be sent; if not received within 7 days of the request, wages continue as penalty at the same rate until paid, max 60 days. Exception: primarily-commission employees whose net pay needs an audit. No resignation-timing rule in this section.

instrument_name: RSMo 290.512 Tipped employees and goods/services as wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Tipped employees: employer pays not less than 50% of the state minimum wage (2026: 7.50/h = 15.00 x 0.5, derived), total compensation must reach the minimum wage, employer makes up the difference. Goods/services as incident of employment: fair market value credit computed weekly.

instrument_name: RSMo 290.500 Definitions (minimum wage law exclusions)
figure_or_rule_carried: Excluded from 'employee': bona fide executive/administrative/professional; volunteers; occasional private-residence work <=6h per occasion; casual babysitting; retail/service business with annual gross volume < 500,000; government positions per 29 USC 203(e)(2)(C); 29 USC 213(a)(8); uncontrolled commission salespersons; caddies/newsboys; tuition-offset student workers; offenders. Learner/apprentice = under 20, max 3 (6) months.

instrument_name: RSMo 525.030 Wage garnishment limits
figure_or_rule_carried: Max garnishable per workweek (after legally required deductions) = least of 25%, excess over 30x federal minimum wage, or 10% if the employee is head of a family and a Missouri resident. Limits do not apply to support orders, Chapter XIII bankruptcy orders, state/federal tax debts. Longer periods: month = 4 1/3 weeks, semimonthly = 2 1/6 weeks. No discharge for garnishment for any one indebtedness.

instrument_name: RSMo 285.304 Content of new-hire withholding forms
figure_or_rule_carried: New-hire report minimum content: employee name, address, SSN, date services first performed; employer name, address, FEIN; if a form other than the W-4 is used, also the date the employee signed the W-4 or the hire date. (Deadline per Form 4282 s.8: within 20 days of hire.)

instrument_name: RSMo 290.140 Service letter on request
figure_or_rule_carried: Corporations with 7+ employees: an employee with 90+ days of service who is discharged or quits and requests in writing by certified mail within 1 year gets, within 45 days, a signed letter stating the nature and duration of service and the true cause of separation.

instrument_name: Missouri DOLIR Division of Labor Standards - Minimum Wage page (2026)
authority: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Labor Standards
article_or_section: 2026 Minimum Wage; Tipped Employees; Employers Subject; History; Posters
figure_or_rule_carried: 2026 minimum wage 15.00/h; tipped employees at least 50% = 7.50/h plus top-up to 15.00; retail or service businesses with annual gross income < 500,000 not subject; history 2015 7.65 ... 2024 12.30, 2025 13.75, 2026 15.00; poster required by RSMo 290.522 (English and Spanish versions in effect Jan 1-Dec 31 2026). Second independent document family for the 15.00 in US-MOS5-002.

instrument_name: RSMo 290.505 Overtime compensation
figure_or_rule_carried: Overtime 1.5x regular rate over 40 hours/workweek; amusement/recreation businesses meeting 29 USC 213(a)(3): 1.5x over 52 hours/week; employees exempt from FLSA minimum wage or overtime (29 USC 207, 213) are exempt; interpreted per FLSA and Portal-to-Portal Act. No daily overtime.

instrument_name: RSMo 288.036 Wages defined - state taxable wage base mechanism
figure_or_rule_carried: UI wages include commissions, bonuses, non-cash remuneration, FUTA-reportable tips; exclude sickness/accident/medical/death plan payments, 401(a) trust and 404(a)(2) annuity payments, employer-paid FICA for domestic/agricultural service, Section 125 cafeteria payments that are not FUTA wages; domestic and agricultural: cash wages only. Wage base set annually from the 4-quarter average trust fund balance: <=350M -> +1,000; >=650M -> -500; floor 7,000, cap 13,000 (from 2010). G-DERIVE: 2025 9,500 -> 2026 9,000 = -500 step, consistent with the >=650M branch and with DES page US-MO-P5-2-005. Caveat: the displayed version (H.B. 150 of 2015) carries a Revisor note 'declared unconstitutional' (Pestka v. State, SC95369, 2016); the wage-base mechanism is restated identically by the DES guide (US-MOS5-013).

instrument_name: Missouri DES Employers Rights and Responsibilities under the Missouri Employment Security Law (MODES-INF-151 (10-25) AI)
authority: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Employment Security
article_or_section: pp.5, 13-15, 17, 22 (liability, wages, taxable wage base, contribution and wage report, online reporting, localization, posters)
figure_or_rule_carried: Liability: 1,500 payroll in a quarter or a worker in 20 weeks; domestic 1,000 cash in a quarter; agricultural 10+ workers in 20 weeks or 20,000 cash in a quarter; government any worker. Taxable wage limitations 2022 11,000 / 2023 10,500 / 2024 10,000 / 2025 9,500 / 2026 9,000 (+1,000 / -500 steps; 7,000-13,000). Quarterly Contribution and Wage Report (MODES-4; instructions MODES-4-5): worker name, SSN, wages paid in the quarter, work-separation dates and probationary dates (<=28 days, flag P); due last day of the month after quarter end (Apr 30, Jul 31, Oct 31, Jan 31); online via UInteract (Method B file upload; payroll services NASWA/ICESA format); employers filing W-2 electronically with SSA (50+ employees) must report quarterly wages electronically; spec labor.mo.gov/media/pdf/m-inf-368-ai. Late penalty 10% of tax or 100, whichever greater. No part of the tax may be deducted from pay. Localization: localized / base of operations / direction and control / residence; Interstate Reciprocal Coverage election. Poster MODES-B-2 required. 401(k) elective deferrals are UI wages.

instrument_name: RSMo 288.034 Employment defined (UI coverage of domestic/agricultural/religious/student service)
figure_or_rule_carried: UI excludes: church/religious-order employment and ministers in their ministry; agricultural labor unless employer paid 20,000+ cash in a quarter or had 10+ workers in 20 weeks; domestic service unless 1,000+ cash in a quarter (subs. 13); student working for own school; students in credited work-study programs; full-time students at organized summer camps < 13 weeks. Wayback snapshot 2025-04-21 (latest available); later amendment not checked.

instrument_name: RSMo 143.121 Missouri adjusted gross income (starts from federal AGI)
figure_or_rule_carried: Missouri AGI of a resident = federal AGI with listed modifications; no addition for 401(k)/403(b) deferrals, Section 125, HSA, transit or group-term life appears among the additions read (subs. 2(1)-(6)); withholding wages = federal wage definition (Form 4282 s.4). Missouri follows federal pre-tax exclusions for withholding.

instrument_name: RSMo 407.1355 Social Security numbers - prohibited actions
figure_or_rule_carried: Private persons may not publicly post or display an SSN (incl. to co-workers); require transmission over the internet unless secure/encrypted; require SSN to access a website without a password/PIN; use the SSN or (after 2015-12-31) its last four digits as an employee number. Use required by state/federal law or for internal verification allowed. No explicit pay-statement SSN truncation rule in the Missouri statute read.

instrument_name: RSMo 454.505 Administrative income withholding for support
figure_or_rule_carried: Support withholding order binding 2 weeks after mailing/electronic issuance; employer may deduct an additional fee up to 6 per month, total within CCPA 15 USC 1673(b); remit within 7 business days of payday to the payment center; priority over any other state legal process; concurrent support orders pro rata on current support; notify the division within 10 days of termination with last address and new employer; no discharge/discipline (30-day rebuttable presumption); fine up to 500; out-of-state orders: law of obligor's principal place of employment governs fee, maximum and timing.

instrument_name: RSMo 143.011 Resident individuals - tax rates - rate reductions - bracket indexation
figure_or_rule_carried: Base table 1.5% to 6% in 1,000 steps; top rate 4.95% from 2023 (subs. 2), top rate applies above 7,000 as adjusted; subs. 3: one 0.15-point cut from 2024 if net general revenue exceeds the best of the prior 3 years by 175M; subs. 4: up to three further 0.1-point cuts, one per year, if revenue triggers (200M, inflation-adjusted) are met; bracket eliminated once top rate falls below it; subs. 5: brackets indexed annually by CPI-U (Sep-Aug average vs Sep 2014-Aug 2015), published by DOR from Oct 1. G-DERIVE: 4.95 - 0.15 - 0.10 = 4.70 = the 2026 top/supplemental rate in Form 4282 (US-MOS5-001), so one subs. 4 cut has been applied and two remain possible (4.6, 4.5). 2026 bracket width 1,348 = 1,000 x indexation factor 1.348 (DOR figure). Wayback snapshot 2026-08-03 predates the 2026-08-28 effective date of 2026-session acts: a 2026 amendment cannot be excluded from this read.

instrument_name: RSMo 407.1500 Breach of security - notice to consumers
figure_or_rule_carried: Personal information = name with SSN, government ID number, financial account/card number with access code, medical or health insurance information, unless encrypted or redacted ('redacted' = no more than five digits of an SSN or the last four digits of DL/ID/account number accessible). Breach notice to affected Missouri residents without unreasonable delay; notice to the Attorney General and nationwide consumer reporting agencies when more than 1,000 residents are notified; Attorney General exclusive action, civil penalty up to 150,000 per breach.

instrument_name: Form MO W-4 Employee's Withholding Certificate (Revised 12-2024)
figure_or_rule_carried: Fields: full name, SSN, home address; Line 1 filing status (Single or Married spouse works or MFS / Married spouse does not work / Head of household); Line 2 additional withholding per period; Line 3 reduced withholding (fixed amount replaces standard calculation); Line 4 EXEMPT with reasons (no liability last and this year - renew annually; MSRRA military spouse; active-duty Armed Forces income). The current edition remains Rev. 12-2024 on the 2026-08-18 snapshot; used with the 2026 formula. No allowance count.

instrument_name: Missouri Secretary of State - 2026 Ballot Measures (November 3 2026 general election)
article_or_section: Amendment 7 (SS SCS SJR 95); Amendments 3/6/8; Proposition A
figure_or_rule_carried: Certified for 2026-11-03: Amendment 7 (SJR 95, 103rd GA 2nd Reg. Sess.) - Show-Me Prosperity Fund endowment, would eliminate state-imposed taxes only once fund earnings suffice; fair ballot language: no immediate impact on taxes. Status: proposed constitutional amendment, vote pending on 2026-11-03, not in force. Level: none for 2026-2027 payroll (no withholding change). No 2026 ballot measure on minimum wage or paid sick leave is listed. Other measures (abortion, initiative process, sheriffs, congressional map) not payroll-relevant.

instrument_name: Missouri DOLIR Division of Labor Standards - Wages, Hours and Dismissal Rights page
authority: Missouri Department of Labor and Industrial Relations, Division of Labor Standards
article_or_section: Reducing/Deducting Wages; Work Hours and Overtime; Vacation Pay and Sick Leave; Breaks; Termination/Final Wages
figure_or_rule_carried: Wage reduction needs 30 days' advance written notice (not for fewer hours or a change of position); penalty 50 per affected person. Deductions for register shortages, damage etc. allowed if pay stays at or above minimum wage. Overtime over 40 hours/week, no daily overtime; no waiver. Vacation, holiday, severance and paid sick leave not required (contract/policy governs payout). No adult break requirement (entertainment-industry youth: meal break before 5.5 h, 15-min rest per 2 h). No state job-protected illness leave beyond FMLA. Discharge: all wages due at dismissal; certified-mail request, 7 days, penalty wages up to 60 days. Notify Family Support Division within 10 days of terminating an employee under income withholding.
